headline: TSLA eyes weekly loss (-3% WTD) as retail investors grill Musk on missed robotaxi targets — top Say Technologies questions ahead of Jul 22 Q2 earnings: 'Why has Tesla missed short-term robotaxi guidance 3 earnings in a row?' and 'When will Cybercab start customer rides?'; investors demanding concrete fleet size, paid rides, intervention rates, cost per mile, and revenue contribution instead of broader progress updates; Koyfin projects Q2 revenue +17% YoY, adjusted EPS +31% YoY; TSLA -0.3% premarket Thursday after closing at $394.46 (-0.43%) Wednesday as pre-earnings positioning weighs on stock (Stocktwits / Yahoo Finance, Jul 16, 2026)

Tesla Q2 2026 earnings preview: TipRanks consensus EPS $0.52-0.55 (+30-38% YoY), revenue $25.81B (+14.8% YoY); top investor questions are unsupervised FSD point-to-point summon timeline, when Cybercab will start public customer rides, first Optimus production unit count, and automotive gross margin vs Q1's 21.1% — options market still pricing 7.6% move either direction; 7 analysts revised Q2 estimates higher since Jul 13; earnings July 22 after market close (TipRanks / Benzinga, Jul 15-16, 2026)

Elon Musk announces product gallery at Texas ranch — 52 products spanning 1984-2025: from a $500 video game he coded at age 12 to the Tesla Cybercab and SpaceXAI; curated 'lifelong work that changed the world' exhibit; includes Tesla, SpaceX, Neuralink, Boring Company, and xAI milestones; announced July 15, 2026 (Teslarati, Jul 15, 2026)

FSD v14.3.5 third deployment wave pushes to ~1,210 additional AI4 vehicles July 15 — Tesla has now run three rapid deployment waves of build 2026.20.6.6 in quick succession; third wave reached approximately 1,210 more AI4-eligible vehicles as of ~7:26 PM UTC on July 15; aggressive three-wave rollout cadence signals Tesla is building confidence in the v14.3.5 branch ahead of July 22 Q2 earnings; key UX additions include camera preview accessible at any time (not just during active FSD) and live FSD status indicator in Tesla app; pace is consistent with Tesla's staged validation approach before broad fleet deployment to the full HW4 fleet (basenor, Jul 15, 2026)

Wells Fargo raises TSLA PT to $130 from $125, still implies 67% downside — analyst Colin Langan lifted Tesla's price target on July 14 but maintained Underweight; at ~$399 current price, the $130 target implies roughly 67% decline; Langan's core bear case: stock already prices in a future Tesla has not yet delivered, negative FCF, and a $25B capex cycle with uncertain payback timeline; joins JPMorgan and GLJ Research as structural bears heading into July 22 Q2 earnings; consensus analyst PT now $402.69 across 29 analysts (TipRanks Jul 15), reflecting a historically wide $130–$650 spread as bull/bear divide intensifies pre-earnings (Yahoo Finance / Wells Fargo, Jul 14–15, 2026)

Chamath Palihapitiya calls Tesla-SpaceX merger 'very obvious industrial logic' — TSLA +0.4% overnight — in CNBC interview, Palihapitiya (early SpaceX investor via Founders Fund) said combining the two companies would create one capital structure and balance sheet for Musk's broader ambitions; he previously predicted SpaceX would reverse-merge into Tesla rather than pursue a traditional IPO; Jefferies simultaneously published a note saying SpaceX merger 'could hand shareholders a premium' with Musk retaining 55.3% voting control of the combined entity; both remarks reinforce that the SpaceX IPO (Jul 10, SPCX, $1.77T valuation) has removed the primary 'SpaceX is private' structural barrier to a deal; TSLA closed Tuesday at $396.18 (+0.40%); next major catalyst: Jul 22 Q2 earnings (Stocktwits / CNBC, Jul 15, 2026)

Jefferies raises TSLA PT to $400 (from $375), SpaceX merger could hand shareholders premium; Tesla Semi begins Chicago cold-weather pilot with Paper Transport — Jefferies cited Tesla's 'significant auto volume beat' (480K vs 406K consensus), raised Q2 EBIT to $1.45B / 5.1% margin, increased FY26 EBIT 4% to $6.2B; group revenue seen at $28.7B; Q2 capex $6.9B; still expects $7.5B FCF outflow; Jefferies says multi-year growth/earnings deterioration 'beginning to reverse'; Tesla Semi Chicago pilot with Paper Transport targets 500-mile cold-climate range validation — success would expand addressable market to harsh-winter regions; maintains Hold (Jefferies / Stocktwits, Jul 14–15, 2026)

Tesla Q2 2026 energy deployment: 13.5 GWh (+53% QoQ) — record Q2 in company history, confirms Q1 8.8 GWh miss was timing not demand — closest prior Q2 was Q3 2023's 12.5 GWh; Megapack backlog remains 2–3 years deep; at Q2 run-rate Tesla is tracking toward ~54 GWh full-year 2026 vs ~48 GWh consensus; energy gross margins to be revealed in Jul 22 Q2 financials; energy recovery removes a key bear narrative from Q1 and directly supports the $10B+ energy revenue thesis for full-year 2026; Model Y L launch (Jul 3) and Optimus ramp also add new 2H revenue streams (teslaoracle.com / Tesla IR, Jul 15, 2026)

Tesla Robotaxi fleet near-flawless in new NHTSA safety report (Apr 15–Jun 16) — Tesla logged only 1 incident in 62 days of unsupervised Austin operation: a zero-fault event where a stationary Robotaxi obeying a red arrow signal was rear-ended by a human-driven pickup truck; Zoox logged +6 incidents, Waymo +191 in the same period; data not normalized by fleet miles, but confirms Tesla's Austin operational envelope is performing at extremely high reliability; directly challenges the '4x human crash rate' framing from earlier NHTSA filings; strongest safety data point yet heading into Jul 22 Q2 earnings (notateslaapp / NHTSA filings, Jul 13, 2026)

Tesla Cybercab confirmed giving employee rides at Giga Texas as of July 10 — Tesla official X account posted video of production Cybercab (no steering wheel, no pedals) autonomously picking up and dropping off employees in the Giga Texas outbound lot; basenor: 'Tesla has quietly crossed a line that no major automaker has crossed before'; Electrek raised ambiguity on whether operations are parking-lot-only or extend to public roads; a clip of Robotaxi app vent-control UI briefly visible in the original post was later edited out by Tesla, prompting speculation on app feature depth; first time purpose-built Level 4 hardware has transported actual passengers at commercial-adjacent scale; key operational bridge between production ramp and public commercial launch ahead of Jul 22 Q2 earnings (basenor / notateslaapp / Electrek, Jul 10–13, 2026)
